Method of Attack: Ransomware attack involving encryption of systems and data exfiltration
Stealing databases with sensitive patient information
Publishing stolen data on a leak site (HiveLeaks) on the dark web to pressure victims
Impacted Systems: Memorial Health System network including Marietta Memorial Hospital, Selby General Hospital, Sistersville General Hospital, outpatient service sites, and provider clinics
Attack Vector: Network intrusion followed by data exfiltration and ransomware encryption
Indicators of Compromise: Stolen databases containing information of 200,000 patients including social security numbers, names, and dates of birth
